The original Kotlin compiler, in all-compatibility mode, provides the actual
static interface accessor and invokespecial default dispatch. No input Code,
descriptors or flags are encoded. An original anonymous callback tests moving
one default body with its local declaration. The frozen observer distinguishes
default dispatch from an override, checks captures, nulls, effects, exact
failures and source enclosing-method metadata, and rejects independently
compiled wrong results, effects and virtual dispatch.
